rules.title: Owner’s spending mandate is valid
rules.message: The agent can only spend under a mandate the owner signed, and only until it expires.

rules.title: A plain merchant payment
rules.message: A spend is one to four payments to merchants, and nothing else.

rules.title: Allowed kind of shop
rules.check: tx.payouts.destinations().all(d, att.list('merchant.category/1', 'classifier').exists(c, c.subject.account == d && c.claim.category in mandate.categories))
rules.message: Every merchant must be classified by an accepted classifier into a category the owner allowed (for example groceries).

rules.title: Within the weekly cap
rules.message: Everything spent in the last 7 days, including payments still settling, stays under the mandate’s weekly limit.

rules.title: Within the overall budget
rules.message: Everything spent over the mandate’s 90-day period, including payments still settling, stays within its budget.

rules.title: Matches the merchant’s payment request
rules.message: When paying a merchant’s x402 or MPP request, the payment must go to the address, for the amount and invoice, that the merchant asked for, so it can’t be redirected or replayed.

rules.title: Valid owner close
rules.message: The owner closes the account by sweeping everything back to themselves, then deleting it.
